name: exportData
shortDescription: Exports specified data in a given format (CSV/PDF) for analysis or compliance purposes.
description:
Overview

This function enables administrators to export data from various entities into specified formats like CSV or PDF, facilitating external analysis or compliance requirements.

Intended use

Called by the admin dashboard UI when an administrator initiates a data export. Parameters include the entityType (e.g., 'Doctor', 'MedicalRecord'), format ('CSV', 'PDF'), and optional filters.

Logic

  1. Validate the requested entityType and format.

  2. Query the specified entity (e.g., Patient, Doctor, Appointment, MedicalRecord) using ctx.data.query, applying any provided filters.

  3. Convert the retrieved data into the requested format (CSV or PDF).

  4. Return the exported data as a file or a link to a generated file.

Entities

  • Patient

  • Doctor

  • Appointment

  • MedicalRecord
